srList.sentence: To maximize external validity and to ensure an even representation across the larger study sample, the size of each age subgroup (6-year-olds, 7-year-olds, etc) and sex subgroup (female and male) was restricted to a maximum of 30 patients.

srList.sentence: Patients included in this study had to have undergone ACL reconstructive surgery between July 2008 and July 2018, be younger than 16 years of age, and have records of skeletal age and a knee radiograph within a 3-month span (Figure 1).
